in_marathi.name: Krupaali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krupaali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of mercy and compassion. She is the embodiment of unconditional love and kindness. In Hindu mythology, Krupaali is considered the mother of all beings and is often invoked for her blessings.

in_bengali.name: Krupaali
in_bengali.long_meaning: Krupaali একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess of mercy and compassion. She is the embodiment of unconditional love and kindness. In Hindu mythology, Krupaali is considered the mother of all beings and is often invoked for her blessings.

vedic_reference.note: Goddess Kali, a form of Shakti, represents compassion and mercy. Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity, is also known as the goddess of compassion and grace. Krupaali is a name that embodies both these aspects of the divine feminine.
